name: holistic-workspace
comment: Repo-root pnpm workspace for the Holistic dashboard (frontend/app). The project-neutral SDK (holisdk/*) is NOT vendored here: holisdk is its own repo, linked in as a sibling at setup time (see .gitignore /holisdk + services/dashboard/install.sh) and consumed as @holisdk/ui. The dashboard is application-specific; the SDK never lives inside it (architecture / sdk-boundary).
